semiconductor_relevance: High — Geckos Technology Corporation specializes in advanced materials for semiconductor packaging, particularly focusing on anti-oxidation nano-copper technology.
summary: Geckos Technology Corporation develops innovative materials for semiconductor applications, particularly focusing on anti-oxidation nano-copper paste that maintains high conductivity and thermal properties in challenging environments. Their products are designed to address application bottlenecks in traditional copper materials, enhancing performance in semiconductor packaging.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Geckos plans to establish its first mass production plant for nano-copper powder and an advanced nanotechnology laboratory in the Central Taiwan Science Park by the end of 2024.
